title: Columbia Throttle Tube
body_html:
Columbia Tools is excited to introduce the newest addition to the Carbon Fiber family — the ThrottleTube.

Built for professional drywall finishers, the ThrottleTube is designed to deliver joint compound to corners quickly, smoothly and with precise control. This tool features a  carbon fiber tube, providing superior strength and durability compared to traditional plastic tube designs while keeping the tool balanced and easy to handle.

A simple twist of the grip activates the internal piston, allowing compound to flow smoothly when needed and stopping instantly with a release of the twist for full control during application.

The white mud level indicator rod clearly shows the compound level. As the tube is filled, the rod extends outward, and when the red indicator becomes visible, it signals the tube is full. As compound is used, the rod gradually retracts back into the tube.

title: Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound 43lb Pail
body_html:
Fast, simple, and effect are the best descriptors of Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound.

Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound is a unique damping product that is ideal for new construction and renovation projects. As the most cost-effective soundproofing material on the market, the Green Glue’s distinctive properties dissipate the vibrations caused by sound waves as they travel through ceilings, walls and floors.

The compound is a viscoelastic damping compound that converts sound energy into a minute amount of heat. Very simply, when used between two rigid layers of material, typically drywall, the compound works to isolate the noise traveling from one room to the other. Unlike other soundproofing products, Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound is ideal for dissipating low frequency noise common with home entertainment and theater systems.

Applied in mere minutes to an average piece of drywall (or other rigid construction material), Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound can be applied to an entire room in one day, or less. Whether you’re an experienced construction professional or a handy DIY kind of person, using Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound is a cinch. All you need is a standard quart-sized caulking gun to apply a layer of compound between two pieces of drywall or other construction material. The Compound reaches its peak performance 30 days after application.

Independent lab tests prove that Green Glue’s effectiveness in markedly increasing STC ratings in a wide variety of construction configurations. Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound is environmentally-responsible and has low odor; it’s a cost-effective solution that allows you to live and work in peace. Add value and comfort to your home or commercial space by decreasing noise in your environments.

Material Considerations

Despite the Green Glue name, Noiseproofing Compound is NOT a permanent adhesive. The Compound is used between two layers of building materials – typically drywall, OSB, MDF, cement board, or plywood, each at least 1/2 inch (12 mm) thick. One of the layers of which must allow moisture to pass through. So long as the two sheets layers are flat, rigid (for example, being applied between a layer of drywall and soundboard is not a good application), the Noiseproofing Compound will perform well.

Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound should not be used between one or two soft layers, plastics, glass, or metals – i.e. between a carpet pad and plywood or to fill any cavities, such as inside a wall for insulating purposes.

We do not recommend using the Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound on exterior applications as it is effective only at room temperature range (approximately 65-85°F / 18-29°C). Exteriors are often subject to temperature fluctuations which are below and above this range. Please note: if the Noiseproofing Compound is subjected to temperatures outside of this range, including during transport, it will return to regular performance once it has warmed/cooled to the 65-85°F (18-29°C). range. Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound is freeze and thaw stable.

Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound has been proven to work in conjunction with the following materials:

  • DRYWALL – Click here for recommendations on drywall assemblies. You may use factory-damped drywall, but you can save yourself the extra expense by simply using extra layers of standard drywall with Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound.
  • WOOD PRODUCTS – Medium-density fiberboard (MDF), Oriented strand board (OSB) and plywood for applications like floors, soffits, seating risers in home theaters, stages, loudspeaker cabinets, and others.
  • INSULATION – common building fiberglass (yes, the fluffy pink stuff) works just as well or even better than pricier insulation materials.
  • SOUNDBOARD – we recommend using as an underlayment for flooring rather than for walls and ceilings because soundboard lacks the mass required for effective damping.
  • MASS LOADED VINYL – MLV and other limp mass products with Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound
  • SHREDDED RUBBER UNDERLAYMENTS – the heavier and thicker, the better. Use compound on a solid surface and not on mesh or open-web underlayments.
  • STEEL STUD WALLS – Green Glue Noiseproofing Compound also performs outstandingly with steel stud walls. For details and information about specific wall types, click here.

The Stealth Sander is an internal 90 deg sanding tool that uses geometry to solve some typical sanding problems.
One end forms a 95 deg included angle, while the other end forms 85 deg.

It is best used with Wallpro Stealth Super Pads that fit perfectly and provide an excellent abrasive surface. (5 pack SCP-220-5)

The sander fits onto a standard corner finisher/glazer handle (CFH-1200 or CF-XH), with hook (from hook and loop) tape on the outer surface.
As the outer edge and the transition are at an angle to the direction of travel, it helps reduce scratching and lines or grooves.
The Stealth Sander provides a very quick and easy method of giving finished internal angles a final touch up.

Features

  • Protection rating IP 54.

Product advantages

  • Compact laser, always ready to hand and ready for use.
  • GREENBEAM technology for long, high-visibility laser lines.
  • Cross lines and plumb-line dots for a wide range of applications.
  • Casing can be rotated inwards for effective protection of the optics.
  • Flexible positioning: 1/4" thread, magnets, laser base, wall bracket.

Application examples

In drywall construction: suspending ceilings in conjunction with the wall bracket, transferring layouts from the floor to the ceiling, aligning profile rails and positioning partition walls. For tiling work: marking out the tile layout, aligning and laying floor and wall tiles. In electrical installation work: marking switches and sockets, aligning cable ducts horizontally and vertically to each other, aligning and mounting lights. For installation work: aligning pipe hangers vertically and horizontally to each other, laying cables and heating pipes, mounting radiators and sanitary facilities. For joinery: assembling kitchen cupboards, aligning worktops. In window fitting: leveling the window height.

title: Mud n’ More MixBall – Mixes Quick-Setting Drywall Mud, Paint, Grout, Mortar and More. Mixes Fast and Smooth with Any Drill. Easy Clean-Up, Wet or Dry
body_html:
A universal kit that mixes quick setting drywall compound and more in seconds with no mess and no guess. Includes precision measuring cups for accurate mix ratios that can be doubled or tripled depending on the amount of material needed. Mixes materials smooth in just seconds with the flexible and waterproof MixBit that works with any drill. Squeeze the materials out of the MixBall into your mud pan or work directly out of your MixBall. The MixBit is also made of flexible, non-stick material with a galvanized, waterproof metal shaft. The ball design eliminates any mess while mixing by keeping the materials contained. Kit includes (1) MixBall, (1) 6 oz. precision measuring scoop, (1) 8 oz measuring cup, (1) MixBit. A must-have for all trades. Heavy duty, flexible materials. Works great at mixing all quick-setting mud, all grout, mortars, plaster patch, sand into paint, cement, and much more. The MixBall easily flips inside out to clean with water, or let the materials harden and crumple out into the trash. How to use the Mud n' More MixBall: (Ingredients can be doubled) 1) Use the Precision Measuring Cup (with a handle) to add 3 scoops of drywall compound into the MixBall. 2) Fill the Precision Measuring Cup (without a handle) with water and pour into the MixBall. 3) Insert the MixBit into your drill. Mix the contents for 10-15 seconds or until thoroughly blended. Additional mixing time may be needed if ingredients are doubled. 4) Squeeze the contents out of the MixBall into your pan and begin working. How to clean the Mud n' More MixBall: The MixBall can be cleaned before (wet) or after (dry) the compound has hardened. WET: Turn the MixBall inside out and wash clean. DRY: Squeeze the MixBall and the hardened material will easily break up & fall out.
  • Mixes quick-setting drywall compound smooth and fast
  • Precision measuring cups take the guesswork out of mixing ratios
  • Eliminates the mess and time of manually mixing in a pan

title: USG™ Plaster Bonder (3.7L Pail)
body_html:
USG™ Plaster Bonder is a vinyl acetate homopolymer emulsion designed to provide a strong, durable bond between new plaster and any **structurally sound interior surface**. It ensures excellent adhesion and compatibility across a wide range of substrates, including:

  • Gypsum plaster
  • Concrete and cinder block
  • Stone
  • Gypsum drywall panels
  • DUROCK® Cement Board
  • FIBEROCK® Abuse-Resistant Gypsum Fiber Panels

When applied as a uniform continuous film using a brush, roller, or spray, the bonder dries quickly and will rewet when plaster is applied, forming a secure, integral bond. Once dry, surfaces may be plastered the same day or left unplastered for up to **10 days** without compromising performance.

USG Plaster Bonder should not be used around swimming pools, in highly humid environments, or on the underside of concrete roof decks. For decorative finish systems, only Clear Bonder is recommended, as the pink tint can show through.

Install Guides

  • Material - Solid Steel

INSTALL GUIDE

FAQ

What material can this be used with?
This luxe hidden receptacle mount is designed specifically for drywall and gypsum walls or ceilings. If you're working with other materials, use the Framed No-See Receptacle Mount [Luxe] — it’s compatible with any surface.

What can I use this for?
This no-see outlet mount is extremely versatile and can be used to recess and conceal any electrical receptacle. It’s perfect for places where switches and outlets are necessary, but you don’t want to see them.

My wall is already installed. Can I use this product?
Yes, absolutely! Just be prepared for a bit of drywall mudding and sanding to ensure a flush, seamless look. If you’re looking for something a bit more DIY-friendly, use the Framed No-See Receptacle Mount [Luxe]. When installing, be conscious of wall studs. Position the product between studs for a seamless result.

Can I use this for any receptacle style?
Yes! This minimalist receptacle mount is compatible with light switches, outlets, Ethernet and phone electrical boxes.

Does the door have to be open to access the receptacle?
You need to open the door to access the receptacle, but a handy notched inlet allows power cords to stay plugged in while the door is closed, so you can keep the door closed while using the outlet.

Framed or Flush? What's the difference between the Flush Drywall No-See Receptacle Mount [Luxe] and the Framed No-See Receptacle Mount [Luxe]?
This is the Flush model, designed to be mudded in, creating a seamless, contoured look that blends into the wall, so it’s best installed by a professional. In comparison, the No-See Receptacle Mount has a rim that sits on top of the wall surface, creating a visible border and allowing for an easy, DIY-friendly drop-in installation.

Can I use this product on floors, walls, and ceilings?
This high-end hidden outlet mount for walls and ceilings is designed for use with drywall and gypsum surfaces only.

Does this require electrical prep work?
No electrical prep work is required for installation of this concealed receptacle mount. However, we recommend consulting with an electrician before proceeding.

Are there restrictions on wall plate sizes?
Yes, check the detailed dimensions for compatible wall plate sizes.

When you say easy to install, just how easy is it?
This is a Flush model. It requires mudding and sanding to achieve a flush finish, so it’s best tackled by someone experienced with drywall. If that’s not you, we recommend calling a pro!

Do you make custom sizes or colors?
No, we don’t offer custom sizes or colors. However, you can paint or wallpaper them however you like for a seamless design.

Can I paint it?
Yes! This customizable hidden outlet mount is specifically designed to be painted to blend into the wall. Use a paint that is suitable for powder-coated galvanneal steel. We recommend using a primer before painting for best results.

Is the utility box included?
Yes, each hinged receptacle mount includes an appropriately sized utility box (1 gang or 2 gang).

Is the wall plate included?
No, wall plates are sold separately. The receptacle mount is compatible with recommended brands like Leviton, Lutron, and Eaton.

body_html:
Due to their lightweight design and ease of use, skimming blades are becoming an increasingly popular tool in the drywall finishing industry.

Columbia Composite-Body Skimming Blades come in a variety of lengths up to 48 inches and feature a flexible, high-precision 0.3mm stainless steel blade inserted into a rigid composite handle profile. These tools are exceptional for smoothing fresh drywall compound with even distribution and superior control.

Why Choose Columbia Skimming Blades?

Not all skimming blades are created equal. Columbia Skimming Blades offer professional finishers a unique combination of balance, precision, and performance features that set them apart.

A Unique Blade Edge

The true advantage of Columbia skimming blades lies in their high-precision 0.3mm European stainless steel inserts, designed to provide just the right amount of flex for efficient, effortless skimming and smoothing.

While most blade edges are stamped flat with squared corners that can hinder mud flow, Columbia skimming blades feature a proprietary rounded edge profile that allows drywall compound to roll smoothly and evenly off the blade—delivering superior results with less effort.

The raised, rounded blade corners also help eliminate lap marks, ensuring a consistent, streak-free finish when working over large areas.

Replaceable Blade Inserts

Skimming blades are precision tools and can be damaged on the job if dropped. Columbia’s innovative design allows for quick, tool-free blade insert replacement. Simply remove an end cap to slide out the damaged insert and replace it—saving you time and money by avoiding the need to replace the entire tool.

title: Joest 9" Round Drywall Sanding Discs Variety Sampler (10 Pack)
body_html:
Perforation

Jost products have holes throughout the surface that allow the dust to easily escape, and Eliminate Load-up. Because you won’t have dust particles clogging up your paper, you can now use the full potential abrasive life of the sheet. Perforation allows the sheet to last longer and provide a higher level of finish.

Fiber Backing

Jost abrasive drywall sanding sheets utilize a Non-Woven backing that draws the dust through the portholes evenly. Not only is the backing a nice additional cushion, but it drastically improves the performance and life of the sanding sheet. Even distribution of sanded drywall material means you can Eliminate Sand Scratches!

Aluminum Oxide Grit

Traditional drywall sandpaper uses sharp edged silicon carbide abrasive that starts out cutting hard, but doesn’t wear evenly. Joest Drywall Sanding Sheets utilize Aluminum Oxide grit that is rounded (instead of jagged), and wears uniformly. Jost products will cut at the same rate throughout their useable life, and will resist loading.

They don't scratch the wall like other discs

Jost grit particles have more rounded edges to help eliminate scratch marks. Grit rating is a measure of grain size not sharpness. For sanding drywall mud, sharp grit is bad!

They last much longer

The Jost sanding disc and foam pad have air passage ways which carry the drywall dust away from the sanding pad to keep the disc cleaner and cooler for longer life. High speed sanders tend to create heat which strips the glue and sand from the disc. Use only Jost sanding discs with the Jost foam pad. It is the only system which has air flow that carries the drywall dust from the sanding surface to the vacuum.

title: Strait-Flex Medium Flexible Corner Bead – 2 1/4″ x 100'
body_html:
The slotted edge design facilitates a superior bond to the drywall substrate, providing clean corners without paper fuzz-up during finishing and sanding. Medium is ideal for bay windows, coffered ceilings, or any inside corner where gaps are present. Apply with all-purpose joint compound.

  • Twice as fast and twice as strong as conventional paper or mesh tapes
  • Inside corners where small gaps in drywall are present
  • Inside 90° corners where a small fill or minor straightening is required, no back-filling needed
  • Great for vertical and wall-to-ceiling inside corners, inside angles of bay window

Installation

  • Cut Medium to the desired length and trim the ends at 45-degree angles. Fold Medium in half at the center crease with the print sides facing each other. For inside corners, fold less than the desired angle with the print side facing out.
  • Apply all-purpose compound to the corner. Press Medium into the wet compound, adjust to create a straight line, and wipe down with a taping knife.
  • A second coat can be applied immediately. Let this dry completely, for several hours or overnight.
  • With a 6”or 8” taping knife, apply your final coat of compound, feathering the compound beyond the previous coat. For inside corners, a very light coat of compound is all that’s needed. Let this dry completely, for several hours or overnight.
  • Sand lightly with 120 grit sandpaper. Medium will not fuzz-up like paper or mesh tapes.

HELPFUL HINTS

  • Use a stainless steel mud pan to carry and re-mix compound as you work. Keeping your compound smooth and free of air pockets and dried clumps of compound will deliver a smooth finish.
  • Have a five gallon bucket of water with a durable sponge handy for cleaning tools.
  • When painting, apply a base coat of drywall primer to seal the compound and assure an even paint finish.

title: SlurryTub Trade Kit
body_html:
On the job, SLURRYTUB is a straightforward piece of kit. It uses a single-use biodegradable filter that is placed into the tub and secured down by attaching the 4 holes into the cleats. Slurry waste is then poured into the tub, and hand tools and equipment can be washed down with the runoff flowing into the tub. The filtered water is then drained safely in washout areas or recycled on the job. Most of the water should drain within 30-60 minutes depending on the slurry contents. When dry enough, dispose of the hardened waste, along with the biodegradable filter into the work site waste disposal bin at the end of the day. Way too easy!

Features

  • Heavy-duty recyclable polypropylene tub, designed to drain quickly
  • Made to support most wheelbarrows, handsfree
  • Corner cleats to hold the filter in place
  • Drain plugs with threaded holes, suitable for standard 20mm tap and hose fittings
  • Compatible with SLURRYTUB single-use, biodegradable filter papers
  • Dimensions: 36 x 24 x 13 in
  • Weight: 18 lbs

title: Joest Ocean Pad for Guppy Holders  Fish Shape
body_html:
With the Jöst Guppy Ocean Pad you can re-equip the guppy holder and quickly and reliably remove algae, lime and other deposits in your fresh or saltwater aquarium.

In addition to regular and permanent water maintenance, cleaning your aquarium is also an important part. Apart from the visual factor, algae can reproduce uncontrollably if they are not removed regularly. Regular cleaning of the aquarium and its parts also ensures safe and reliable operation.

With the Ocean Pad for the Guppy Sponge by Jöst you are perfectly equipped if you want to clean your aquarium in no time. The 3cm thick foam rubber sponge in a fish shape (not included in the contents of delivery) fits perfectly in your hand and allows you to work quickly and without fatigue, because it effortlessly follows every movement. The special and innovative appearance of the guppy sponge allows you to clean even difficult to access cracks and corners in the aquarium without having to clear out the entire aquarium. The changeable pads help you with this: the rough ocean pad has a special structure, thanks to which you can remove stubborn limescale and algae deposits from the panes, for which you would normally use a blade. With the guppy sponge, you reduce the risk of accidentally cutting silicone seams or even cleaning scratches in the windows. (Nevertheless, you should make sure that there are no pebbles or grains of sand when cleaning between the guppy sponge and the glass, as these would scratch the aquarium glass very well!) You can also use it to improve any unsightly discolouration on your silicone seams!


You can even use the guppy sponge to clean the outer aquarium panes and just polish them with a microfibre cloth or chamois. This not only saves you a lot of expensive cleaning agents but also makes an active contribution to environmental protection - if cleaning doesn't make you twice as happy!

Dimensions 3 cm

Colour White

PU/piece 1 pcs.

title: Joest Superclean Pad Set
body_html:
The Superclean PAD from Jöst aquaristic is really the perfect tool and the dream of every cleaner for the aquarium! It is super easy and convenient to use.

With it you can safely and super-thoroughly remove even the most stubborn, annoying algae: point algae, crustal algae ... are history in an instant with this great tool. Neither crusts nor deposits are safe from the Superclean PAD, and best of all: the PAD works with water alone, you do not need any cleaning agents.

Place the PAD with the rough side on the perforated surface of the Catfish holder, it will hold there by itself ... and off it! With the fine side of the Superclean PAD, you clean the inner pane as well as the outer pane of your glass case without scratching. You can then finally see your fish again!

Remember that only a slightly damp pad can clean the outside of your aquarium.

Before using it for the first time, rinse the reusable Superclean PAD briefly with tap water and squeeze it out a little. You can also wash dirty pads under tap water and let them dry before putting them in your closet.

Not only can you thoroughly clean the inside of your aquarium with it, but also the exterior, and just with water so you do not need any potentially dangerous cleaning agents that would endanger your stock in the aquarium. For external cleaning, dampen the pad slightly for best results.

The Ocean PAD is optimized for use on glass and leaves no scratches.

Wash the Ocean PADs briefly under running water before using them for the first time. After use, you can also wash the pad out again, let it dry and you can then reuse it.

title: Joest Microfibre Glove Set
body_html:
Joest aquaristics has developed the microfibre Pentagon glove for all those who like to lend a hand. Clean your aquarium panes yourself in no time at all, easily and comfortably!

The inside of the Pentagon glove holds various cleaning pads, which of course are also included in the set. With the Superclean PAD you line up the aquarium panes and polish them to a high gloss.

Simply place the PAD on the black perforated surface of your Pentagon glove - and off you go. The rough side must lie on the holder, the fine side comes to the glass. This will get rid of even the most stubborn algae, even green point algae are no problem for the Superclean-PAD. You can also use it to clean the outside windows of your aquarium thoroughly and simply with a little water - you do not need any cleaning agents here. Everything from Jöst aquaristic is 100% gentle on your aquarium glass and does not scratch you.

Wash both the Pentagon glove and the Superclean PAD with tap water before using it for the first time. If the glove and PAD are dirty, just wash them under running water, that's enough. Then you let everything dry and you can use the cleaning products for your aquarium again.

The set also includes a thin protective cover, which you put on the perforation of the glove when you throw it into the washing machine if it is heavily soiled. Wash the glove at a maximum of 60 ° C. After the wash cycle, remove the protective cover and keep it dry for the next machine wash.

Dimensions 26 x 16 cm

Colour Pink

title: Joest Guppy Holder, Ocean Pad & Superclean Pad
body_html:
In addition to regular water maintenance, cleaning your aquarium is also an important part. Apart from the visual factor, algae can reproduce uncontrollably if they are not removed regularly. Regular cleaning of the aquarium and its parts also ensures safe and reliable operation.

With the Guppy sponge by Jöst you are perfectly equipped if you want to clean your aquarium in no time. The thick foam rubber sponge in the fish shape fits perfectly in your hand and allows you to work quickly and without exertion because it effortlessly follows every movement.

The special and innovative appearance of the guppy sponge allows you to clean even difficult to access cracks and corners in the aquarium without having to clear out the entire aquarium. The two different and changeable pads help you with this: the rough pad has a special structure, thanks to which you can remove stubborn limescale and algae deposits from the panes, for which you would normally use a blade. With the guppy sponge, you reduce the risk of accidentally cutting silicone seams or even scratches in the panes. (Nevertheless, you should make sure that there are no pebbles or grains of sand when cleaning between the guppy sponge and the glass, as these would scratch the aquarium glass very easily!) With the fine coating, you can remove fine dirt from plastic surfaces, which you normally remove laboriously and soak in aggressive detergents.

Thanks to the practical "Guppy-Mouth" you can even clean the spaces between overflow shafts in no time and if you are very careful, even your large-leaved aquatic plants! To do this, you should support the leaves with one hand if you are practising magic with the Guppy sponge. You can also use it to improve the unsightly discolouration on your silicone seams!
You can even use the guppy sponge to clean the outer aquarium panes and just polish them with a microfibre cloth or chamois. This not only saves you a lot of expensive cleaning agents but also makes an active contribution to environmental protection - if cleaning doesn't make you twice as happy!

Dimensions Pack of 3

Colour Blue/white

PU/piece 1 pcs.

title: Joest Chamois Leather Pentagon Set
body_html:
With the PENTAGON chamois leather, you can clean your aquarium perfectly without streaks after wet cleaning and give the panes a new shine. The Pentagon chamois leather perfectly fits the separately available microfibre Pentagon glove. Simply place the chamois leather with the rough side on the perforation of the glove - and off you go.

All cleaning products from Jöst aquaristic are 100% gentle for use on glass and they do not leave any scratches - not even the chamois. The end result is best if you lightly dampen the chamois before cleaning. If you have washed it out beforehand, you should wring it out so that it is only a little bit moist. Then you can clean the windows with a cleaning pad and wipe with the chamois for a perfect result.

Please rinse the PENTAGON chamois leather under running water before using it for the first time. You do the same for cleaning. Then let the chamois dry out and keep it. You can use it many times.

Dimensions Pentagon (37 cm x 37 cm)

Colour yellow

title: Joest Catfish Holder
body_html:
With the Catfish holder in a set with the Ocean-PAD and the Superclean-Pad in 10 x 15 cm, you clean your aquarium panes extensively and remove all dirt on the panes, including bacterial films and algae deposits.

The cleaning pads fit easily into the perforation of the holder and make your aquarium panes clean from the outside and from the inside down to the pores, without any cleaning agents, just with water.

The set includes 1 x the Ocean PAD from Jöst aquaristic, with which you can roughly pre-clean or perform a quick basic clean, and 1 x the Superclean PAD, which gives your work the necessary finish and trims your aquarium panes to a high gloss.

You can use the Ocean-PAD on both sides, it adheres to the holder with each side. You turn the Superclean-PAD with the rough side towards the holder so that the fine side can clean the aquarium glass.

All Jöst aquaristic products are guaranteed to be scratch-free and gentle on the glass. If you clean the outside of your tank, make sure that the PAD is slightly damp so that the panel gets really clean.

Please wash the Ocean-PAD and also the Superclean-PAD a little bit with tap water before using them for the first time and squeeze them out a little so that your aquarium windows are clean without streaks. You can briefly squeeze out used PADs after use and then continue cleaning. If you want to clean the PADs properly, please do not do this in the aquarium, but hold them under a tap water jet or squeeze them out in a bucket of clear water. If you store the PADs dry, you can reuse them.

Dimensions 8.5 x14 cm

Colour blue

PU/piece 1 pcs.

title: Joest Oceanpad Pentagon Set
body_html:
The scratch-free and glass-protecting Ocean-PAD is of course also available for the separately available Pentagon microfibre glove. You can use it to wipe irritating algae and other ugly dirt off your aquarium glass without any cleaning agents. The Ocean PAD is particularly well suited for rough cleaning and pre-cleaning from the outside and inside.

The glass-friendly and scratch-free PAD fits the perforation of the glove, and off you go! With this you can easily and comfortably clean the inside and outside of your aquarium. It doesn't matter which side you use to place the pad in the perforation, both sides can be used.

For external cleaning, dampen the pad a little so that the dirt can be easily removed. You don't need any detergents.

Before you start cleaning, clean the new Ocean-PAD briefly under running tap water. After cleaning, you can wash the reusable pad again under tap water. Allow to dry well before storing.

Dimensions 10 x 15 cm

Colour White

title: Joest Superclean Pentagon Set
body_html:
Just put the pentagonal Superclean PAD by Jöst aquaristic for the Pentagon microfibre glove in the perforation of the glove and you are ready to go. The pad is the perfect tool to keep track of things in the aquarium, and it's really super easy and comfortable to work with.

The Superclean PAD takes even the most stubborn point algae and crust algae and eliminates all possible crusts and smears. Also great: The Superclean PAD works with pure water, you don't need any cleaning agents here.

The PAD comes with the rough side in the perforation of the Pentagon microfibre glove, where it sticks by itself. The fine side of the Superclean PAD cleans the aquarium panes sparklingly clean and without scratches. Finally, you can see your aquarium inhabitants again! Please remember to lightly dampen the pad before cleaning the outer panes, otherwise, you will simply wipe over without cleaning.

Before the first use, the reusable Superclean PAD is briefly rinsed under tap water and squeezed out. You can easily wash dirty pads with tap water and keep them dry until next time.

Shape: 10 x 15 cm

Colour: Grey

title: Joest Microfibre Cloth - Soft & Dry
body_html:
Woah, drops of water on wooden furniture or a valuable parquet floor? Water stains can be avoided when you have the Micro Clean towel at hand - a total must-have for every aquarist.

Due to the pleasant material and the super suction power, the towel helps you in many situations with any work on your aquarium. With the Micro Clean microfibre cloth from Jöst aquarists, you dry your hands quickly, remove water stains before damage occurs, or even quickly clean the dripped outer panes, for example after changing water. The Micro Clean towel is super gentle on the glass and leaves no scratches.

Please note the care instructions on the label. The towel can be washed in the washing machine with similar colours up to 60 ° C. Please do not use fabric softener and do not bring the cloth into contact with substances that may contain chlorine.

Dimensions 40 x 40 cm, 40 x 80 cm

Colour Blue

PU/piece 1 pcs.

title: Joest Ocean Wave for Panel - Magnet
body_html:
Do you have a magnet cleaner and are you almost happy with the result? With the Ocean Wave attachment from Jöst aquaristic you can spice up all commercially available magnet cleaners and at the same time protect your aquarium glass from scratches. The deep cleaning effect ensures unbeatable cleaning results.

The attachment for magnet cleaners has a rough Velcro side, which you attach to the cleaning surface of the magnet. Fits practically every standard algae magnet cleaner for the aquarium. Jöst aquaristic purposely chose the size so that the attachment looks a little over the magnetic surface. You can either leave them alone or cut them a little with scissors. The attachment is scratch-free and gentle on the glass.

The thinner Ocean Wave attachment for magnet cleaners is 5 mm thick. This brings a lot of magnetic force to the glass and even removes point algae where your algae magnet cleaner would have been left algae sitting in the corner for a long time.

The cleaning result of course always depends on the glass thickness of your aquarium. With a strong algae magnet you get enough pressure on the panels - the more the better.

The Ocean Wave attachment is briefly washed through with tap water before the first use and then squeezed out, as well after cleaning. Please store the attachments dry. You can reuse them very often.

Dimensions 9 x 8 x 0,5 cm / 9 x 8 x 1,1 cm

Colour White/Blue

PU/piece 5 pcs.

title: Air King Fire Rated Exhaust Fan
body_html:
Not all Fans are Created Equal Life Safety Professionals work hard to develop and enforce building codes to eliminate or reduce potential threats. Nothing can be more frustrating and sometimes more costly than not having the correct product to comply with the building code for your project.

Wood is a Combustible Material When you’re building a multi family residential project using wood frame construction you’ll need to comply with stringent requirements to prevent the spread of fire. These are likely to include the use of fire rated products for ceiling penetrations such as bathroom exhaust fans. Air King Fire Rated Fans have been tested and are UL Listed for use in wood frame construction and have been successfully tested by UL in more truss designs than any major manufacturer. You will see competitor certifications that will say “For use in any fire resistive Floor or Roof-Ceiling assembly”. That does not necessarily mean UL listed for wood frame construction. Wood construction is NOT fire resistive; wood is a combustible material that fire fighters usually consider fuel. The UL requirement for Listing in this case requires mounting and testing of the fan in each approved truss design above an actual fire. You know you have the right product for the application when the manufacturer provides the truss design numbers for which the product was tested. No design number - Not UL Listed for wood frame construction. Air King Fire Rated Fans on the other hand are currently UL Listed for the greatest number of wood frame truss designs. Be sure you have the right product and save yourself a lot of time and trouble by starting with Air King.

title: Aria Lite+ High Performance Framed Floor Vent
body_html:
We’ve reimagined old-fashioned grill vents. This high-performance, ultra-minimalist design has all the features of the Framed Floor Vent [Lite]—plus a double air channel that delivers +50% more airflow¹. It’s a high-performance upgrade that delivers serious power and great value.

A customizable center tray hides the vent in plain sight for a clean, modern finish. Better looking than a traditional grille, it’s a design-forward upgrade that works with any material. Super-easy, 15-minute DIY install. Retrofit anytime. HVAC-compatible and works with all flooring types.

Features

  • Sleek, minimalist design — simplify and declutter your floors for a modern look
  • Customize with tile, hardwood, vinyl or carpet
  • Double channel for increased airflow performance
  • High performance airflow
  • Durable ABS plastic
  • Also available in a seamless Flush model
  • Easy to clean
  • Child + pet friendly
  • Patented design, made in North America
  • Optional Lite Dampers sold separately

Install Guides

INSTALL GUIDE

FAQ

What material can this be used with?Almost any. Like all Fittes floor vents, this high-performance, framed floor vent is compatible with tile, hardwood, carpet, vinyl, laminate, cork, and more. For Lite+ models, the surface material must be between ⅛” and ¾” thick.

My floor is already installed. Can I use this product?Yes! This is a framed floor vent for any surface material. All you need is a piece of your flooring material to place inside the inner tray.

Will this product work with my HVAC system?This HVAC-compatible framed floor vent is airflow tested and designed to work with most standard systems, but it’s always a good idea to consult your HVAC specialist to ensure that this product is right for yours.

Framed or Flush? What's the difference between the Framed Floor Vent [Lite+] and the Flush Floor Vent [Lite+]?This is the Framed model, with a thin rim that sits on the surface, creating a visible border and allowing for an easy, DIY-friendly drop-in installation. In comparison, the Flush model sits level with the floor, but must be mounted at the subfloor level, before installing the surface material. Framed Floor Vent [Lite+] does not have built-in airflow control (though you can purchase Lite Dampers separately if needed). The Flush Floor Vent [Lite+] has built-in dampers.

What's the difference between Lite, Lite+, Luxe and Luxe+?_x005F_x000B_We offer four vent collections, each thoughtfully engineered to give you the flexibility to choose what fits best in your space. Here’s how they compare:_x005F_x000B_+ Lite and Lite+ are made from durable ABS plastic—Lite features a single air channel for everyday airflow, while Lite+ adds a second channel for +50% more airflow._x005F_x000B_+ Luxe and Luxe+ are crafted from solid steel—Luxe delivers a premium, built-to-last design with a single channel, while Luxe+ doubles the airflow, delivering +50% more airflow than standard Luxe._x005F_x000B__x005F_x000B_

Whichever option you choose, our patented vents are a clear upgrade from old-school grilles.

Can I use this vent on floors, walls, and ceilings?This Framed floor vent is designed for heavy materials like tile and wood. It works on floors, and walls that are tiled or wood panelled, but is not compatible with drywall and would not work on ceilings. For drywall and ceiling application, use the Flush Wall Vent [Lite+].

When you say easy to install, just how easy is it?This is the Framed model — installation is simple and requires minimal tools. Just cut a piece of your flooring material, glue it onto the vent’s inner tray, and screw it in for super-easy, DIY framed floor vent installation. In comparison, the Flush model needs to be professionally mounted at the subfloor level, before installing the surface material. Check our handy install guide for step-by-step instructions for both models.

Do you make custom sizes or colors?No, we don’t offer custom sizes or colors. However, we do have a wide range of sizes available, and you can customize all Fittes vents with a leftover piece of surface material — simply cut and glue the material onto the inner tray for a stylish framed floor vent that blends with surfaces.

Red Bull Sea Blue Edition captures the bold, refreshing taste of Juneberry—a bright berry flavor—combined with Red Bull’s signature energizing formula to give you “wiiings.”

Key Benefits

  • Flavorful and Energizing: Delivers a unique berry twist while offering Red Bull’s energy-boosting performance.

  • Either Sugared or Sugar-Free: Choose a version that suits your dietary preferences and energy needs.

Versions & Ingredient Highlights

Version Highlights
Sugar-Free • Caffeine: ~80 mg per 8.4 fl oz can—supports alertness.
• Calories: ~10 kcal per can.
• Sugar: 0 g.
• Contains taurine and essential B-group vitamins (B3, B5, B6, B12).
• Vegetarian-friendly, gluten-free, dairy-free, wheat-free, lactose-free.
Regular (Sugared) • Caffeine: ~114 mg per 12 fl oz can (higher than the sugar-free version).
• Sugars: ~38 g per can (comparable to apple juice).
• Calories: ~160 kcal per can.
• Includes taurine and B-group vitamins (B3, B5, B6, B12).

Common Features Across Both Versions

  • Ingredients include high-quality carbonated water, taurine, caffeine, natural and artificial flavors, and B-vitamins.

  • Comes in aluminum cans that are highly recyclable.

  • Enjoyed by a wide range of consumers—athletes, gamers, students, travelers, and anyone leading an active lifestyle.

title: Red Bull Zero Energy Drink
body_html:
Red Bull Zero delivers that classic "gives you wiiings" boost with zero sugar, offering the energy of Red Bull without the calories.

Key Benefits

  • Enhances Alertness and Concentration: Contains caffeine for mental stimulation.

  • Reduces Fatigue: Enriched with B-group vitamins (niacin/B3, pantothenic acid/B5, B6, B12) that support energy metabolism and fight tiredness.

  • Sugar-Free Energy: Delivers the familiar Red Bull taste using low- and no-calorie sweeteners instead of sugar.

Ingredient Breakdown (Typical 250 ml / 8.4 fl oz Can)

  • Caffeine: ~80 mg per 250 ml can—comparable to a cup of home-brewed coffee—for improved focus.

  • Taurine: A naturally occurring amino acid, abundant in heart and muscle cells; supports cellular hydration and balance.

  • B-Group Vitamins: Includes niacin (B3), pantothenic acid (B5), vitamin B6, and B12—aid normal energy-yielding metabolism and reduce fatigue.

  • Sweeteners: Uses a blend of erythritol, sucralose, and monk fruit extract—non-caloric substitutes that maintain flavor without sugar.

  • Water: The drink’s base ingredient, contributing to its signature taste and consistency.

Dietary & Safety Features

  • Zero Sugar / Low-Calorie: Ideal for those mindful of sugar intake or calories.

  • Similar Functional Formula: Contains the same core active ingredients—caffeine, taurine, B-vitamins—as original Red Bull, but with a sugar-free profile.

  • Options Vary by Region: Sweetener combinations may differ by market and the can label provides the most accurate, up-to-date info.

title: Red Bull Original Energy Drink

Benefits

title: Columbia Semi-Automatic Taping Tool Set with Bonus Hand Tool Set
body_html:
The Columbia Semi-Auto Taping Tool Kit can significantly increase your taping and finishing production capabilities when compared to hand taping. Semi-Auto taping tools greatly increase efficiency and consistency compared to hand taping and decrease waste, resulting in reduced material use. The corner and flat compound applicators can be attached to the Columbia Compound Tube, allowing drywall mud compound to be easily and evenly applied to flat seams and corner angles. The corner roller is then used to bed tape squarely and securely into inside drywall angles. The final touch is using the corner flusher to apply an equal, feathered finish to inside corners. The entire kit fits in the included convenient, custom-crafted tool carrying case, for easy transportation, storage and protection of your tools.

Features

  • The included compound tube allows you to evenly apply compound where you need it.
  • Includes all the tools needed for each step of the taping process in one handy kit.
  • The included case gives your tools the protection they need and make it easier to transport to the job.

title: Resilmount A48R Right Angle Sound Isolation Bracket
body_html:
Resilmount® A48R is an engineered, acoustic resilient mounting bracket for reducing airborne vibration and structure-borne vibration in internal wall and ceiling applications. Used to brace an acoustic wall to the structure without compromising sound and vibration transmission requirements.

Resilmounts patented thermoplastic rubber outperforms standard rubber because of its unique natural absorbing characteristics. Resilmounts unique sound cell design guards against structure-borne vibrations transferring into the body of the Resilmount because of its strong column design providing a small percentage of contact surface area with the structure or substrate it is fastened to. This aids in absorbing and breaking up airborne sound at its transfer point.

Features

  • Unique, patented sound cell design to break up and absorb airborne sound.
  • Engineered thermoplastic rubber outperforms standard rubber because of its sound absorbing characteristics.
  • A48R is perfect for decoupling wall systems.
  • A48R can be used to decouple almost anything from garage door motors to lockers.
  • Resilmount is the most cost effective way to isolate airborne noise.
  • Strong ‘column’ design provides minimal contact area with substrate whilst maintaining maximum structural integrity.
  • Provided with several 3/16” slotted holes in bracket surface, suitable for direct fastening applications.
  • 1/4” hole for most common fittings like 3/16” suspension rod.

title: Resilmount A50R Sound Isolation Ceiling Hanger
body_html:
Resilmount® A50R is specifically designed for the support and acoustical isolation of internal suspended ceiling systems.

Rubber mounts differ from spring mounts in that the natural frequency is a function not only of the deflection but also of the rubber hardness. The noise absorption properties of the Resilmount A50R allow it to deflect 3/16”, in accordance with American Standards, which provided optimal isolation of transferred noise.

Features

  • Designed for a universal fit with all hanger wire.
  • Can be installed into either a new or existing ceiling system.
  • Acoustically tested for STC and IIC.
  • Does not reduce the load capacity of the ceiling system.
  • Suitably isolates the ceiling system from the structure to reduce structure and airborne noise.
  • Three profiles of the A50R address the weight bearing requirements of various suspended ceiling systems: Red (65lbs per hanger), Black (120lbs per hanger), Blue (200lbs per hanger).

title: Aria Lite+ Framed High Performance Wall Return
body_html:
We've reimagined old-fashioned grille vents. An innovative, ultra-minimalist design with all the features of the Framed Wall Vent [Lite], plus an additional channel for +50% increased airflow*. Customizable center tray hides vents in plain sight. Super-easy, DIY-install in 15 minutes. Retrofit anytime. Drywall- and HVAC-compatible.

*Increased airflow is compared to Lite standard models. Will vary based on size.

Features

  • Sleek, minimalist design — simplify and declutter your walls and ceilings for a modern look
  • Customizable with paint or wallpaper
  • Double channel for increased airflow performance
  • High performance airflow
  • Also available in a seamless Flush model
  • Easy to clean
  • Child + pet friendly
  • Patented design, made in North America

Install Guides

INSTALL GUIDE

FAQ

What material can this be used with?This high-performance, flush wall vent is designed specifically for drywall or gypsum walls and ceilings.My wall is already installed. Can I use this product?Yes, definitely! Our products are designed for both pre- and post-drywall installation. Just be prepared for a bit of drywall mudding and sanding to ensure a flush, seamless look. If you’re looking for something a bit more DIY-friendly, use the Framed Wall Vent [Lite+]. When installing, be conscious of wall studs. Position the product between studs for a seamless result.Will this product work with my HVAC system?The Flush Wall Vent [Lite+] is an HVAC-compatible, double-channeled, flush wall vent, which is airflow tested and designed to work with most standard systems, but it’s always a good idea to consult your HVAC specialist to ensure that this product is right for yours.Are these vents compatible with filters?Not at the moment, unfortunately. Our vents aren't designed to fit filters right now, but we're actively working on a solution. Watch this space!Framed or Flush? What's the difference between the Framed Wall Vent [Lite+] and the Flush Wall Vent [Lite+]?This is the Flush model, which sits level with the wall surface. It requires drywall mudding and sanding for a seamless wall vent installation, so it’s best installed by a professional. In comparison, the Framed model has a rim that sits on top of the wall surface, creating a visible border and allowing for an easy, DIY-friendly drop-in installation. Neither of these products have integrated airflow control, although dampers can be purchased separately if needed.Lite or Lite+? What's the difference between the Flush Wall Vent [Lite] and the Flush Wall Vent [Lite+]?This is the Lite+ model, a double-channeled, ABS flush wall vent for those who want a little extra “oomph”. It has all the features of the Flush Wall Vent [Lite] and is also equipped with an extra air channel that allows for increased airflow. Both the Lite and Lite+ models offer an affordable wall vent with recessed design, made from durable ABS plastic.

Can I use this vent on floors, walls, and ceilings?The Lite+ flush wall air vent system is compatible with drywall or gypsum. It can also be used on ceilings, but would not work on flooring.

When you say easy to install, just how easy is it?This is the Flush model. It’s an ultra-minimal wall vent that requires mudding and sanding to achieve a flush finish, so it’s best tackled by someone experienced with drywall. If that’s not you, we recommend calling a pro! Alternatively, use the Framed Wall Vent [Lite+] — installation is simple and requires minimal tools. Just cut a hole in the drywall (if needed) and fasten with the provided screws. Check our handy install guide for step-by-step instructions for both models.

Do you make custom sizes or colors?No, we don’t offer custom sizes or colors. However, we do have a wide range of sizes available, and you can paint or wallpaper them however you like for a cost-effective, flush wall air vent upgrade.

Can I paint it?Yes! This affordable, high-airflow, flush wall vent is specifically designed to be painted to blend into the wall. Just use a paint that is suitable for ABS plastic. We recommend applying a primer before painting for the best results.

title: Columbia Predator Full Semi-Automatic Taping Tool and Sanding Set with Bonus Hand Tool Set
body_html:
The Columbia Full Semi-Automatic Taping Tool Kit can significantly increase your taping and finishing production capabilities when compared to hand taping. Semi-Auto taping tools greatly increase efficiency and consistency compared to hand taping and decrease waste, resulting in reduced material use. Apply the tape using a wet-tape system with the Semi-Automatic Taper. The corner roller is then used to bed tape squarely and securely into inside drywall angles. The corner and flat compound applicators can be attached to the Columbia Compound Tube, allowing the second coat of drywall mud compound to be easily and evenly applied to flat seams and corner angles. The corner flushers help to apply an equal, feathered finish to inside corners. Finally, use the best sanding head on the market to sand dried coats. The entire kit fits in the included convenient, custom-crafted tool carrying case, for easy transportation, storage and protection of your tools.

Features

  • Increase your efficiency on the job compared to working with hand tools and waste less material.
  • The included compound tube allows you to evenly apply compound where you need it.
  • Includes all the tools needed for each step of the taping process in one handy kit.
  • The included case gives your tools the protection they need and make it easier to transport to the job.

title: Level 5 Outside Corner Applicator Head (Red)
body_html:
The LEVEL5 Outside Corner Applicator is a specialized tool for evenly applying compound onto 90 degree outside corners.

Connect to any of your favorite LEVEL5 application tools, such as the MINISHOT™ Gas-Assisted Applicator Tube (#4-772), the Compound Tube (#4-741), or Corner Applicators (4-701 & 4-702), and you will make quick work applying bedding mud to outside corners prior to applying bead.

Manufactured from extruded glass-filled polymer, the LEVEL5 Outside Corner Applicator has channels for efficiency applying even ribbons of joint compound through the attachment onto both sides of the corner simultaneously. The LEVEL5 Outside Corner Applicator is longer than other competing applicator heads, which effectively eliminates ‘head flip’ when varying degrees of pressure are applied to the attachment while on the wall.

For handle attachment, the LEVEL5 Outside Corner Applicator features an integrated universal ball socket manufactured from premium stainless steel. This socket is compatible with ball end adapters from most leading manufacturers.

Features

  • Extruded from durable glass-filled polymer
  • Channels designed to apply the perfect amount of bedding mud to outside corners
  • Longer design eliminates the tendency to ‘flip’ during use, like most competing models
  • Integrated stainless steel universal ball socket for handle attachment. Fits LEVEL5 compound applicator tools, as well as those from most other leading manufacturers.

title: Level 5 MiniShot Cleaning Accessory Nozzle Adapter 2 Pack
body_html:
LEVEL5 Cleaning Nozzles not only offer a quick, precise and easy way to clean the interior of the compound tubes for the MiniShot and the Auto Taper, but deliver precise water flow and focused pressure to clean all moving parts on all your drywall finishing tools.

Cleaning your tools is a necessary task at the end of each day. Leaving your tools soiled with remnants of compound drying either inside the tubes or within the filler valves or heads not only creates delays when you require the tool again, but jeopardizes the interior mechanics, including springs, hinges, wheels, threading etc from functioning properly.

This Cleaning Nozzle comes in a pack of 2 and makes quick work of cleaning your tools on the go, or at the end of each day. Remember to oil all moving parts of your equipment after cleaning. Properly lubricating your tools prior to storage will ensure all parts are functioning properly when it’s time to use them again.

HOW TO USE A CLEANING NOZZLE

If you want to hit the ground running each day, the most proactive step you can take is to clean your tools after each use. Follow the steps listed below to clean your MiniShot and keep the mud flowing freely. Note: following these steps each time will eliminate the need to disassemble the MiniShot to clean it.

  1. First, thread a cleaning nozzle to the end of a garden hose sprayer.
  2. Then, rinse the filler valve of the MiniShot before securing the cleaning nozzle to it.
  3. Next, fill the mud chamber of the MiniShot with water. Once the chamber is full, remove the cleaning nozzle
  4. Then, push down on the cone head to let the water evacuate from the chamber.
  5. Once the chamber is empty, reattach the cleaning nozzle to the filler nozzle.
  6. Press down on the cone head and then run the water again. This time, the water will flow out the cone head directly clearing out any accumulated mud.
  7. Now, hose out the top of the cone head to make sure the springs don’t dry out, and rinse out the filler valve one final time.
  8. Finally, turn the MiniShot over to expose the holes at the bottom of the chamber and lubricate with 3-in-1 oil to ensure smooth functioning the next time you use your MiniShot.

TOOL MAINTENANCE & STORAGE

It is important to clean your tools and accessories immediately after each use. Follow these steps to keep your LEVEL5 cleaning nozzle looking and performing like new.

  1. Run warm water over and through the cleaning nozzle to remove any debris or mud.
  2. Store in a dry place.

title: Level 5 Tape Jam Remover Tool
body_html:
Generally speaking, jams will most frequently occur when the cutter blade returns to its retracted position after use. Small pieces of cut tape may catch on the blade after repeated cutting, causing a small obstruction within the left hand side of the taper head (when the head is facing you).

A Tape Jam Remover is a flat and narrow steel tool that is designed to slide easily into the taper feeder slot. Its design gives you a precise feel for the position of the blockage and lets you efficiently dislodge it.

It is important to clean the automatic taper properly after each use so that particles of tape or mud do not have a chance to dry in the head. For cleaning instructions and maintenance tips check out this helpful video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWnWMEwkkg8

HOW TO USE A TAPE JAM REMOVER TOOL

Don’t let a tape jam slow you down on the job site. Follow the steps listed below to quickly eliminate a jam and keep your taper moving.

  1. First remove any tape that is currently in the feeder.
  2. Then, raise the control sleeve of the auto taper to move the advancing needle out of the way so that it doesn’t impede the movement of the Tape Jam Remover tool.
  3. Next, with the control needle out of the way, gently slide the Tape Jam Remover tool into the tape feeder slot. The aim is to move the tool all the way up through the taper feeder slot mimicking the movement of tape through the auto taper.
  4. Then, for the most effective release of the jam, shift the Tape Jam Remover tool from left to right to “feel” for the blockage.
  5. In many cases, the jam will be closest to the retracted position of the cutting blade, in the left side corner of the taper when the taper head is facing you.
  6. Once you have evacuated the jam, you are ready to use the taper again.

TOOL MAINTENANCE & STORAGE

It is important to clean your tools and accessories immediately after each use. Follow these steps to keep your LEVEL5 tape jam remover tool looking and performing like new.

  1. Run warm water over the Tape Jam Remover tool to soften any joint compound that may still be present. Use a brush or sponge with soft bristles to remove any debris or mud. Do not use wire brushes or other harsh abrasives
  2. For a deeper clean, a mild detergent or dish soap can be used with warm water. Rinse the tool thoroughly in warm water, then pat it dry with a soft towel.
  3. After cleaning, store the tool in a dry area.

  • LEVEL5 Tape Jam Remover

title: Flex Resealable Filter Bag (445517)
body_html:
If you find yourself clearing out dirt from your work or living space frequently and burning through filter bags—or worse, your vacuum’s filters—in the process, a resealable bag may be preferable. This product from FLEX is exactly that: a hardy resealable filter bag designed for reusability in FLEX brand HEPA vacuums. Its 3-layer polyester fleece construction makes it durable enough for reuse and well-suited for retaining coarse dirt, filling better without rupturing compared to paper filter bags. More importantly, it can be emptied, cleaned and reused like new. The fleece filter also reduces the strain on the vacuum’s primary filter, preserving its lifespan in turn. Altogether, you save on both vacuum bags and filters when dealing with dirt and debris in your space. This product is made for compatibility with FLEX brand VCE 33 and 44 HEPA vacuum cleaners, operating at 9 gallons or 12 gallons of capacity, respectively. Any class of VCE 33/44 works, though since this bag is meant to be reusable and is most effective with coarse dirt, a class L vacuum may be best—class M and H vacuums are rated for finer mineral or wood dusts, and reusing a filter bag that contained these dusts can be risky since they present a respiratory hazard. Also, the bag is not meant for use with wet/dry vacuuming, though it is moisture-resistant.

Features

The Only One-Piece Angle Head Frames in the Industry
Drywall Master Corner Finishers (aka Angle Heads) are the only corner finishers in the industry that are a one-piece design, machined from a solid block of stainless steel. This ensures a tighter tolerance, and ensures that we are able to hold the smallest gaps between the frames and the body in the industry. This ensures a no-leak design.

The main body is machined from solid billet aluminum, extra thick center clips, and military- grade stainless steel to ensure longevity. title: Never-Miss Colouring Gel
body_html:
Tinting drywall joint compound or spackle with Never-Miss Coloring Gel provides extreme visibility. It is used on the bed and skim coats along with final touch up and when working on patches or repairs. It can be applied in the traditional hand method, with automatic tools. or sprayed on the joints with our finishing system. Using just a small amount of Never-Miss reduces flashing thus helping to consistently achieve a high quality finish on every job.

Use Never-Miss for Touch Up and Tracking

As all drywall finishers know “touch up” is both a tedious and time consuming part of drywall finishing. It is the most costly and labor intensive part of the job. Not to mention, at this phase in the process the work is being evaluated and your performance and quality is under inspection, whether by your imediate employer or the builder. Make sure your finish stands up to the test while expediting the touch-up process. Use Never-Miss, and never miss a spot again.

Never-Miss Coloring Gel Solves Drywall Finishing Problems

Using Never-Miss Coloring Gel at the start leads to better quality control at the finish. Increase your productivity every step of the way. When adding Never-Miss Coloring Gel to your joint compound you will be able to keep track of every last spot on the wall, easily seeing where you have worked and what areas still need attention. Being able to see the touch up spots quickly means a better finish with less time invested.

High Quality Finish

Tinting drywall joint compound or spackle with Never-Miss Coloring Gel provides extreme visibility. It is used on the bed and skim coats along with final touch up and when working on patches or repairs. It can be applied in the traditional hand method, with automatic tools. or sprayed on the joints with our finishing system. Using just a small amount of Never-Miss reduces flashing and photographing thus helping to consistantly achieve a hgh quality finish on every job.

Less Time and Effort

As the compound dries the color rises to the top and then sands away. The color sanding away indicates where it has been sanded thus previnting over sanding. After sanded the places that retain color indicate where touch up is required. Using Never-Miss Coloring Gel for touch up easily guides the drywall finisher back to the places to be sanded or reworked without the use of any special lighting. Spend less time and effort using Never-Miss Coloring Gel.

title: Fittes Framed Hideaway Hook [Luxe]
body_html:
Recessed soft-close hook automatically folds away and blends into wall when not in use. Perfect for entryways, basements, garages or tool sheds. Holds up to 150 lb. Choose the Framed version for a DIY-friendly 15 minute install, or the Flush version for the most seamless aesthetic.

Features

  • Soft-close
  • Framed model is DIY-friendly
  • Folds away automatically when not in use
  • 150 lb weight capacity
  • Available in Framed & Flush Versions

Install Guides

INSTALL GUIDE

FAQ

When you say easy to install, just how easy is it?
It’s simple, and doesn’t require many tools. For the Framed model, just cut a hole in the drywall, grab a screwdriver and tighten the screw. For the Flush model, you’ll need a little more skill to mud the hook into the drywall. This option is best tackled by someone who’s worked with drywall before, so if that’s not you, call in a pro! Follow our handy install guide for step-by-step instructions for both models.

Can I paint it?
Absolutely. Paint it to match your walls for a minimalist’s dream.

What can I hang from it?
The question is really what can’t you hang?! Each hook holds up to 150 lbs, so your coat, purse, backpack, robes and towels are fair game.

How does the soft-close mechanism work?
The soft-close mechanism allows the hook to retract smoothly, silently and automatically, disappearing into the wall when not in use.

Where can the Hideaway Hook be installed?
Just about anywhere you need added storage, from hallways and bathrooms to basements and garages.
The Framed Hideaway Hook [Luxe] can be used on any surface that is ½” - ¾” thick.
The Flush Hideaway Hook [Luxe] is intended for drywall installation.

What colors does the Hook come in?
The Hideaway Hook [Luxe] comes in satin white, however it can be painted or wallpapered any color to match the surrounding wall.

My drywall is already installed, can I use this product?
Yes! The Hideaway Hook [Luxe] can be installed at any time.

What is the difference between the Framed and Flush versions?
The Framed Hideaway Hook [Luxe] is great for DIYers and can be installed in 15 minutes with minimal tools. Just cut a hole in the drywall and secure in place with a screwdriver.
The Flush Hideaway Hook [Luxe] requires drywall mudding for a completely seamless finish, ideal for those who want the hook to disappear into the wall.

title: Festool Planex 2.0 Drywall Sander LHS 225 EQI-Plus and Dust Extractor with Autoclean CT 36 EI AC Combo Package
body_html:
Festool Planex 2.0 Drywall Sander LHS 225 EQI-Plus

The new generation PLANEX long-reach sander is revolutionizing drywall construction – with LED light and random orbit movement. The all round LED light ring works like a built in raking light and reveals any unevenness during sanding. The random orbit sanding motion produces outstanding surface quality – without any expensive reworking. The adjustable suction power, variable working length and clever T-handle ensure ergonomic work on walls and ceilings – making the tool easy to control, even during long periods of operation.

  • Sanding with integrated light: all-round LED light ring to reveal unevenness
  • Easier work: adjustable suction power to relieve the load on the arms and back; the PLANEX holds its own weight against walls and ceilings
  • Individual adjustment: variable working length – up to two extensions can be added
  • Reach further with less weight: ergonomic T-handle for greater range with shorter machine
  • Neat and tidy: safe and space saving transport in the Systainer SYS3 XXL
  • Zero maintenance and durable: the brushless EC motor is extremely robust, long lasting and maintenance free
  • eccentric sanding motion for scratch-free surface quality

Product Highlights

Sanding with built-in LED light ring
A ground-breaking innovation in this product segment is the new LED light ring surround. "When surveying the trade, the same difficulties have come up time and time again: Sanding marks and hard-to-spot irregularities which are only detected later on. The LED light ring built into the new long-reach sander provides perfect illumination in a 50-centimetre radius around the sanding head. This avoids the need for annoying, time-consuming and costly reworking by ensuring a perfect sanding result first time. Even during the test phase, our test tradesman was extremely excited, as the light ring lit up the sanding surfaces like a spotlight," explains Product Manager Simon Gröger.

Eccentric motion for a perfect surface finish
Customers' requirements for the surface finish quality of walls and ceilings are growing constantly and, as a result, perfect sanding results are needed. At the same time, the fillers used are becoming softer, thereby making such high-quality surface finishes harder to achieve. With its eccentric sanding motion, the new PLANEX makes these much easier to accomplish. Thanks to the eccentric sanding motion, premium scratch-free surfaces can be created in the shortest time frame – with no sanding errors or scratch marks.

Healthier working with relief for the arms and back
Ensuring healthy working practices has always been a key concern for Festool. This is why Festool has equipped its new PLANEX with an improved, adjustable extraction system. This means that it can hold its own weight when sanding walls and ceilings, relieving the weight from arms and backs – especially during lengthy tasks. "With the previous PLANEX models, the perfect extraction setting wasn't very intuitive. We have developed the new PLANEX LHS 2 so that the extraction support is more powerful and can be set with a single switch. This greatly simplifies daily sanding tasks," explains Simon Gröger.

In addition, the PLANEX can be individually adapted to the working height because its working length can be extended by to up 2.1 m using two guide extensions. This means that the new PLANEX can be used to sand even very high walls and ceilings. Furthermore, the clever T-handle allows for a longer range, thereby making tasks much easier. Festool has designed the overall handling of the new PLANEX to be highly intuitive: It is very easy to use and stows away perfectly in the new Systainer³ XXL – for secure, compact transportation.

A perfectly coordinated system
High volumes of hazardous sanding dust are generated when sanding plasterboard and drywall filler. Combined with the CTM 36 E AC PLANEX mobile dust extractor and GRANAT abrasive, Festool offers a coordinated system, which ensures a perfect surface finish quality and a healthy low-dust working environment. The new hole pattern in the sanding pad and abrasive ensure an ideal sanding performance with full-surface extraction.

Maintenance-free and durable
Festool has equipped its new PLANEX long-reach sander with the latest generation of brushless EC technology. This means no carbon brushes to be replaced, making the long-reach sander durable and maintenance-free.

Digital extension with the Festool Work App
With the new PLANEX, Festool has enabled full app connectivity.

The following extra features can be accessed in conjunction with the free Work App from Festool:

  • Light control (operation, dimming and individual configuration)
  • Current status (including runtime and temperature)
  • Tutorials for tool operation
  • Application tips
  • Push notifications for machine faults
  • Recommendations for suitable extractors
  • Registration of the machine warranty

With its variety of applications and these additional features, the new PLANEX LHS 2 225 EQI long-reach sander is set to revolutionise daily sanding work on walls and ceilings. Festool is releasing the new PLANEX in the new Systainer³ XXL and in the set version with the matching Festool CTL/CTM 36 E AC PLANEX mobile dust extractor (with the PLANEX hose and new tool storage tray) to the specialist trade.

Festool Dust Extractor with Autoclean CT 36 EI AC HEPA

Functions

AUTOCLEAN automatic filter cleaning for maximum suction.

The CLEANTEC CT 36 EI AC features enhanced AUTOCLEAN main filter cleaning compared to its predecessor, ensuring consistently high suction power, longer working intervals, and an extended filter lifespan with reduced maintenance. It offers intuitive push-button controls for easy operation and includes a built-in Bluetooth® interface, allowing you to start the extractor with a Festool cordless tool or an optional remote control. You can also connect it to the Festool app to set cleaning intervals and manage other functions. The smooth, anti-static suction hose can be conveniently stored in the integrated hose garage.

  • AUTOCLEAN: Enhanced automatic main filter cleaning ensures consistently high suction power. You can set cleaning intervals (15, 30, 60, or 120 seconds) via the app, providing thorough cleaning for heavily clogged filters.
  • Intuitive: Touch controls make it easy to operate the extractor.
  • Automatic Electrical Outlet Module: Designed for corded power tools, this feature starts both the power tool and the extractor automatically.
  • Adjustable Suction Power: Choose from five levels based on your specific application.
  • Smart Technology: Integrated Bluetooth® allows the dust extractor to start automatically with Bluetooth® battery packs or an optional remote control.
  • Convenient T-LOC Function: Easily attach Systainers to the Dust Extractor.
  • Powerful Performance: The compact high-performance turbine ensures consistently strong suction.
  • Antistatic Feature: Prevents static buildup during operation.
  • Organized Design: Hose holder and cord wrap keep everything tidy and easily accessible.
  • Smooth Suction Hose: The conical design provides high suction power and prevents snagging for seamless operation.
  • Easy Transportation: Large pivoting wheels and an integrated brake offer excellent mobility and stability.
  • Cost-Efficient: Maximizes the container’s volume usage for better efficiency.

Usage

Main applications

  • Versatile and clean in the workshop and on the job site, thanks to its compact design and robust capacity.
  • Tool-triggered operation
  • Ideal for dry and wet extraction

title: TapeTech Bazooka Oil
body_html:
Specially formulated for lubricating Automatic Taping and Finishing Tools. Bazooka Oil keeps your tools running free, but more importantly this bazooka oil acts as a water barrier that will keep away corrosion, to extend the life of your drywall tools. Avoid the damage to gaskets wipers and O-rings caused by the use of solvent based lubricants such as WD-40.

Directions

Automatic Taper - Spray entire taper head and tape guid to prevent compound from sticking to tool. Apply extra oil to the creaser wheel, cutter chain wheels, main wheels, springs, gooser assembly, disengaging rod and tape guid. Do not spray tape spool, main tube or control tube.

Mudrunner - Spray on piston wiper, rod wiper and into lubrication ports above handle.

All Other Tools - Spray on rubber gaskets, wipers, O-rings and any other moving parts.

title: TapeTech Compound Roller Support Handle
body_html:
TapeTech drywall joint compound rollers are ideal for applying large amounts of drywall compound on walls and ceilings for finishing large patches and butt joints, or skimming entire walls, ceilings and rooms. They are a great alternative to breaking out a sprayer or trying to apply the compound with knives or trowels. Simply apply the joint compound with the TapeTech premium drywall joint compound roller and then skim the area with a TapeTech premium finishing knife for an amazing finish.

TapeTech compound rollers are designed for use with TapeTech roller frames. The shafts of our dedicated roller frames are a full 5/16” thick, providing the strongest frame in the industry – a must for this heavy-duty application. The roller and roller frames quickly and easily attach to our TapeTech model CROLLHAN2 extendable support handle (44” – 79”) to make quick work of most walls and ceilings without the need for stilts or scaffolds.

Features

  • Ideal Length: The TapeTech CROLLHAN2 Support Handle for TapeTech premium drywall joint compound rollers extends from 44” – 79”, the most versatile range of extension handles for compound rollers.
  • Robust but Lightweight: You don’t want unnecessary weight when you have a roller full of joint compound. The TapeTech CROLLHAN2 is the perfect balance of light weight and robust materials to make you as efficient as possible.
  • Twist and Go: Our simple twist-lock design allows you to quickly make adjustments on the fly, without worrying about mechanical extension failures taking you and your project down.
  • Lock and Load: Our CROLLHAN2 Support Handle quickly attaches to our range of four premium drywall joint compound roller frames and rollers. Frames and rollers are available in 2-inch, 4-inch, 9-inch and 12-inch.
  • Stores Easily: CROLLHAN2 features a hanger at the end of the handle so you can easily hang the handle in your shop, vehicle or on the jobsite, keeping it from constantly falling to the floor when not in use.
Note: Plastering Roller NOT included.
